bar.name: Low Tide
bar.text: Once per battle, when your MP drops below 25%, your next spell costs no MP.

bar.text: When you kill an enemy, your next spell deals 6% more damage.

bar.name: Encore
bar.text: Once per battle, when you drop below 40% HP, all your cooldowns are reset.
